category_title: At-risk students in Applied courses with learned helplessness and inconsistent engagement
scenario_title: Small group project presentations to the whole class
minimal_context: The student's small group is called to the front of the classroom to share their project with the whole class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for your group to come up to the front and share your project with the whole class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to go up there. I don't like being wrong in front of everyone.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone needs to present. Just go up and show us what order you put things in.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Fine. But I know it's wrong. I'm stupid and I'm always going to fail anyway.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just start explaining your project to the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I'm not doing it! The other kids love pointing out mistakes and are just going to say 'well no, you can't put that there because...' and make fun of me.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for your group to come up to the front and share your project with the whole class.

STUDENT: I don't want to go up there. I don't like being wrong in front of everyone.

TUTOR: Everyone needs to present. Just go up and show us what order you put things in.

STUDENT: Fine. But I know it's wrong. I'm stupid and I'm always going to fail anyway.

TUTOR: Just start explaining your project to the class.

STUDENT: No, I'm not doing it! The other kids love pointing out mistakes and are just going to say 'well no, you can't put that there because...' and make fun of me.

context.social_setting: small groups sharing as a whole class

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: if they're up here and it's wrong or put something in the wrong order
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: peers pointing out mistakes and would make fun of these guys up here
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: they don't like being wrong, issues with self-esteem
related_quotes: we l l n o , y o u can’t put that there because

behavior_patterns.condition: lack of success experienced in the school setting
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: demonstrating inconsistent attendance, and/or demonstrating inappropriate behaviour at school
